고객들이 이해하기 쉽고, 지금도 많은 업체에서 널리 쓰는 용어인 만큼 오: They're easy for customers to grasp and still widely used, so we hope they're understood in that spirit.
그러면 이 복원은 왜 하는 걸까요: So why do the repair at all?
The main reason is that it prevents the crack from spreading further.

and the damaged area becomes much clearer, improving your view while driving.
You also save the cost of windshield replacement and re-tinting.

자동차 유리는 녹일수도 없고 운전자의 시야를 확보해야 하는 투명한 재질이: auto glass cannot be melted and must stay transparent for the driver's vision, so

So why does a trace remain even after repair?
Repairing auto glass works in two main stages.
먼저 유리복원 전용 장비로 깨진 틈 사이에 있는 공기를 빨아들여 빈 공간: First, dedicated equipment draws the air out of the break to create a void,
then a special resin with almost the same refractive index as glass is drawn in to fill it completely.
공기가 있던 자리를 레진을 채우면, 빛의 반사가 크게 줄어들기 때문에 하: With resin replacing the air, light reflection drops sharply, so the white and black areas fade noticeably.
돌빵 모양이 꽃모양처럼 크게 깨진 경우에는 레진이 꽃모양 빈틈을 채우면서: Where a chip has broken in a large flower-like pattern, resin filling those gaps can look as though water has pooled there. This isn't a fault in the work —
it's the normal result of resin filling the void.
반대로 돌빵을 오래 방치했다면 먼지와 이물질이 이미 균열 안에 굳어 있기: Conversely, if a chip has been left a long time, dust and debris have already hardened inside the crack, so more trace may remain. For larger damage we sometimes drill to stop the crack extending. In that case
약 1mm 정도의 작은 드릴 자국이 몇 개 남을 수 있는데요: a few small drill marks of about 1mm may remain
— traces left by the process of preventing the crack from spreading.
투명한 유리 특성상 차 밖에서 보는 것보다 차 안에서 볼 때 조금 더 잘: Please note that because glass is transparent, the trace can be slightly more visible from inside the car than from outside.
두번째 단계는 UV(자외선)로 빠르게 경화시켜: The second stage is rapid curing with ultraviolet light
단단하게 굳힙니다. 이렇게 빈 공간 없이 채우고 즉시 굳히는 과정까지 마: to harden it firmly. Only when the void is fully filled and immediately cured
강도도 함께 회복되고, 그 부위가 더 이상 커지지 않도록 예방할 수 있어: does the glass regain strength and the damage stop growing.
경화 후 마지막으로 메꾼 자국을 평탄화시킨 후 샌딩과 폴리싱 처리까지 하: After curing, the filled mark is levelled, then sanded and polished — that's a properly completed repair. The filled area looking faintly marked is inherent to glass repair, not unfinished work. Please understand that this trace is part of a normal repair result.
복원 후 남는 흔적은 기술이 부족해서가 아니라, 투명한 유리이기 때문에: The trace left after repair isn't a lack of skill — it's a natural consequence of glass being transparent.
만약에 새 유리처럼 완벽하게 복원하는 기술이 있다면, 유리 교체 업체는: If there were a technique that restored glass perfectly to new, glass replacement businesses would never have existed in the first place.
돌빵이 발생되면 깨진 부분이 하얗고, 까맣고,반짝거리게 보이는 이유: Why a chip looks white, black and sparkling
돌빵이 생기면 손상 부위가 하얗거나 까맣게,: When a chip forms, the damage appears white or black,
때로는 반짝이는 것처럼 보입니다. 이건 충격을 받은 지점과 그 주변으로: and sometimes sparkling. That's because the impact point and the cracks radiating from it work on different principles.
먼저 돌이 직접 맞은 충격 지점부터 살펴볼게요. 강한 충격을 받으면 그: Start with the point the stone actually struck. A strong impact crushes the glass surface there, creating very fine glass particles.
That white glass powder is why the impact point looks white.
반면 크랙은 원리가 다릅니다. 유리가 갈라지면 틈 사이에 아주 얇은 공기: Cracks work differently. When glass splits, a very thin layer of air forms in the gap. Light that would have passed straight through meets this air layer and the fractured surface, reflecting and refracting — so depending on your angle it can sparkle, or look white or black.
시간이 지날수록 크랙 틈으로 빗물과 먼지 등의 이물질이 들어가 굳으면서: Over time rainwater, dust and other debris enter and harden in the crack, making the damage more visible. Add summer sun and winter heater blasts making the glass expand,
plus driving vibration, and the crack becomes increasingly likely to grow.
repairing a chip as soon as you find it gives the best result.
